usage: policy for approved SAST being disabled
name: The approved static analyzer (SAST) should always be enabled
description: The approved SAST (Static Application Security Testing) application should always be enabled for the code repository.
detailedDescription: SAST (Static Application Security Testing) applications are the most basic type of security vulnerability detection applications that an organization should use. From SQL injections to cross-site scripting SAST applications are a basic requirement to stop easily preventable issues from making their way to production.

args.name: securityTools
args.label: SAST
args.tooltip: Please select one or more approved SAST applications for your policy.
